title: Karnataka govt limits Vande Mataram to 2 stanzas, barring VVIP functions
content: Karnataka's Congress government has ordered singing only two stanzas of Vande Mataram. This directive applies to state government programmes and functions held across Karnataka. The decision follows a Union home ministry guideline for singing all six stanzas. The state government aims for uniformity and appropriate protocol during national song renditions. This move occurs amidst a political controversy surrounding the national song's singing.

title: ED raids Ramnandi Hotels across 9 locations in alleged Rs 132-crore bank fraud case
content: The Enforcement Directorate searched nine locations across three states in an alleged bank fraud case.  Ramnandi Hotels and Resorts Ltd is accused of diverting Rs 58 crore from bank loans.  The company allegedly used fake reports and personal guarantees to secure these funds.  Five pledged properties were reportedly sold at undervalued prices recently.  The agency suspects these actions aimed to prevent asset attachment and recover crime proceeds.

title: Spider-Man, Batman all had to pay rent: Magnus Carlsen, now a father, is no exception
content: Magnus Carlsen’s transition into fatherhood has reshaped how he approaches chess, work and time. Despite unprecedented success, he still sees himself as a provider, balancing the joy of raising his son with the demands of a global career. Fatherhood helped cement his decision to abandon the classical World Championship, revealing a man reallocating ambition around family, responsibility and purpose.

title: Why Apple did not launch successor of the ‘world's most-popular’ iPhone
content: Apple unveiled its iPhone 18 Pro and foldable Duo, skipping the standard model.  This move separates premium and base models into distinct launch cycles.  Memory shortages and supply chain issues likely influenced this strategic decision.  The standard iPhone 18 is now expected in early 2027.  This allows Apple to spread shipments more evenly across financial quarters.

title: Customer complaint over Shoppers Stop carry bag charges rejected; fined Rs 10K

The complainant had previously filed a similar case against the retailer for a carry bag fee.  The commission noted the complainant's history of filing multiple consumer complaints.  This ruling highlights the misuse of consumer protection laws for personal gain.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: Why iPhones are so expensive in India again

Some of that is tax and currency. Most of it is a global memory shortage, squeezed by AI's appetite for chips. Add India's duty structure and Apple's read on what buyers will pay, and the entry fee for an iPhone has never been higher.
